# Copilot instructions

The project rules are in `/AGENTS.md`: follow them. Path-specific rules are in `.github/instructions/`; task playbooks are prompt files in `.github/prompts/` (run them with `/name` in chat).

Most important: selectors only in `src/ui/**/*.locators.ts`; specs import `{ test, expect }` from `src/fixtures`; parameterized SQL and the `soql` template; zod schemas for API responses and test data; never weaken assertions to make a test pass; run `npm run verify` before proposing a change.

Repository map: `ai/context/repo-map.md`.
